card.name: Opening quotation marks starting a quote
card.fires_on: The first word right after an opening double quotation mark that begins a quoted sentence, or the closing quote mark itself, in general prose and news text.

modes.label: Word after opening quote
modes.description: A pronoun or determiner such as I, This, The, We, Some or One that starts a quoted sentence after a period.

modes.label: Quote mark at title end
modes.description: A closing quotation mark or period-quote that ends a quoted title or term.
